integrity: The moment identities and inequalities are proved analytically and supplemented by exact bounded-size enumeration; finite checks are not a proof of an infinite claim. No independent mathematical validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The results concern uniform type-A noncrossing partitions for n>=3. The all-order factor is sharp as a uniform one-step constant and at two marked blocks, not asserted optimal at every fixed m>=3. Factorial-moment repulsion does not imply general negative association. Full historical priority is unconfirmed; previously published generating functions encode the moments.
title: Sharp factorial-moment repulsion for block sizes in uniform noncrossing partitions
